rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for thinking back to past experiences, often with a fond or nostalgic feeling.

example.english: I reminisce about going to the market with my grandma when I was little whenever I have free time.
example.traditional: 我一得閒就會諗返起細個嗰陣同阿嫲去街市。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 dak1 haan4 zau6 wui5 nam2 faan1 hei2 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 tung4 aa3 maa4 heoi3 gaai1 si5

rows.note: Use this when the speaker emphasizes savoring or dwelling fondly on a memorable past experience rather than simply recalling it.

example.english: Whenever I look through old photos, I reminisce about the memorable moments from that trip.
example.traditional: 每當翻看舊相，我都會回味當年旅行的點滴。
example.jyutping: mui5 dong1 faan1 hon3 gau6 soeng2 ngo5 dou1 wui6 wui4 mei6 dong1 nin4 leoi5 hang4 dik1 dim2 dik6
